name: Your Place
source:
Your Place is a 3D visual novel with RPG elements set in a world dominated by women and futanaris.

You are a young man who lives with his two sisters and works like clerk for a big company. One day, when you return from work you are kidnapped and forced to find a mysterious video in which the mayor stars in a hard BDSM session. To do this you must leave your comfort zone and interact with all kinds of characters, adapting to them and finding your place in the world.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/colewallace92]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Your Place》是一部带有RPG元素的3D视觉小说，背景设定在一个由女性和双性人主导的世界中。

你是一个年轻人，和他的两个姐妹住在一起，在一家大公司担任文员。有一天，当你下班回来时，你被绑架了，被迫找到一段神秘视频，其中市长主演了一段艰难的BDSM课程。要做到这一点，你必须离开你的舒适区，与各种角色互动，适应他们并找到你在世界上的位置。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/colewallace92]Patreon[/url]]
